attribution.name: 未署名
attribution.note: Neither the provincial culture department nor the municipal museum page names a writer or calligrapher; the stele itself is recorded by its titles, not its hands.
attribution.noteZh: 省文旅厅与曲靖市政府页面均未记撰文者或书丹者；碑以题衔著称，不以人名传。

compositionDate.note: The inscription dates itself to the fourth year of the 大亨 era, a reign title the Jianning administration kept using after the court had abandoned it. The provincial culture department and the municipal government read that year as 405; a provincial archaeology institute page on the same site gives 404. This record keeps 405 and states both readings.

background: 刻于东晋义熙元年（碑署大亨四年），清乾隆四十三年（1778）在曲靖城南杨旗田出土，后湮没，咸丰二年（1852）重新出土并移置城内武侯祠，1937 年移入曲靖中学（今曲靖一中）碑亭。1961 年列为首批全国重点文物保护单位。碑以方整古拙的书体著称，是研究隶楷之变的重要实物。

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft record. The date, dimensions and relocation sequence come from provincial and municipal pages that were read on 2026-11-18; the stone itself was not examined and the current display position inside the museum was not confirmed.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：草稿记录。年代、尺寸与迁置经过取自 2026-11-18 阅读的省级、市级页面；未核对原石，也未确认其在馆内的当前陈列位置。

notes: The inscription's own date, 大亨四年, is read as 405 by the provincial culture department and the municipal government; a provincial archaeology institute page gives 404. Both readings are recorded.
Published widths differ: 0.68 m (provincial and municipal pages) and 0.86 m (a provincial publicity page). The structured dimensions use the figure the two government pages agree on.
Some later accounts name a writer; the cited government pages do not, so this record asserts no hand.
notesZh: 碑自署「大亨四年」，省文旅厅与曲靖市政府均读作 405 年，云南省文物考古研究所页面作 404 年；两说并存，不作取舍。
公布宽度有 0.68 米（省、市页面）与 0.86 米（云南宣传网页面）两种，结构化尺寸采用两个政府页面一致的数字。
后世有著作称撰书者姓名，所引政府页面未载，故不主张作者。
